catalogue_products.name: Corrugated Rolls
catalogue_products.description: High-shock absorption fluted kraft paper rolls engineered for surface protection and heavy wrapping in transit.

catalogue_products.name: Corrugated Boxes
catalogue_products.description: Heavy-duty 3-ply and 5-ply RSC corrugated shipping containers custom built for industrial export integrity.

catalogue_products.name: Corrugated Sheets
catalogue_products.description: Rigid single and double wall corrugated pads used as layer separators and pallet top protection.

catalogue_products.name: File Storage Boxes
catalogue_products.description: Archival document boxes with reinforced hand-holds and dual-wall crash bottoms for corporate record storage.

catalogue_products.name: Pizza Boxes
catalogue_products.description: Food-grade ventilated E-Flute and B-Flute pizza cartons engineered to retain thermal crispness without moisture buildup.

catalogue_products.name: E-Flute Sheets
catalogue_products.description: Micro-flute sheets ideal for fine litho-laminated luxury retail packaging and crisp printing surfaces.

catalogue_products.name: Masking Tapes
catalogue_products.description: Premium saturated crepe paper masking tapes with residue-free natural rubber adhesive for auto & industrial paint lines.

catalogue_products.name: BOPP Tapes
catalogue_products.description: High-tack water-based acrylic & hotmelt packaging tapes available in transparent, brown kraft, and custom logo prints.

catalogue_products.name: Bubble Rolls
catalogue_products.description: Shock-absorbing air bubble film rolls engineered to cushion fragile electronics, glass, and automotive parts.

catalogue_products.name: Stretch Films
catalogue_products.description: High-elongation cast and blown stretch wrap film rolls for hand and machine pallet unitization.

catalogue_products.name: Edge Protector
catalogue_products.description: Heavy paperboard V-shape angle boards providing stack strength and protection against strap tension damage.

catalogue_products.name: Paper Core
catalogue_products.description: High-crush resistance spiral wound paper tubes used for winding films, textiles, paper, and foil rolls.

catalogue_products.name: PP Strap
catalogue_products.description: Embossed polypropylene strapping bands engineered for high tensile strength in semi-automatic and automatic strapping machines.

catalogue_products.name: Custom Printed Boxes
catalogue_products.description: Bespoke flexographic and offset printed packaging showcasing your corporate brand identity right from the box.

catalogue_products.name: Heavy Duty Octabin Crates
catalogue_products.description: Multi-wall heavy bulk octabins designed to carry up to 1000kg of granular materials and heavy equipment.

catalogue_products.name: Pure Kraft Paper Rolls
catalogue_products.description: Unbleached virgin kraft paper rolls for industrial wrapping, interleaving, and eco-friendly void filling.

layout_and_sections.persistent_header: Floating Glassmorphism Header with warm tint (bg-[#121619]/90 or bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) with Logo, links (Home, Products, What We Do, Industries, About, Contact), CTA 'Request Quote' button + WhatsApp icon button
